receipt_messages.subject: Re: OpenMath: final work and judging materials
receipt_messages.text:
Hi Alejandro,

Since I still do not have access to the official Hill/Climb workflow
or to the public “Nominate a problem” form, I am sending my finalized
immutable artifacts here before the cutoff as a submission attempt and
asking that they be provisionally recorded or linked into the official
submission system.

Target: Černý conjecture
Entrant: Qichao Wang (individual / team of 1)
Submission type: formalized partial advances; I am not claiming a
proof of the general Černý conjecture.

Final immutable commit:
ac948e7001bff5428c22d236f96974856452d34d

Validated mathematical input revision:
f30afd64643d785dff7ec5d44c730cb36a80dce6

Final archive:
openmath-final.zip
SHA-256:
1a09dadd3de876028430fa4dc7aa8353f600075d8daff9c5eae79e0a8ed7c050

The full ZIP is about 27 MB, so I cannot reliably attach it through
Gmail. I have attached the submission document, final validation
receipt, and completion receipts. The package contains the exact
formal theorem inventory, proof-status separation, reproduction
commands, validation logs, certificates, and sealed archive metadata.

The final validation includes the authoritative Lean 4.19.0 modules,
theorem/axiom checks, certificate checks, reproducibility checks, and
repository integrity/seal checks. The two frozen historical Lean
drafts that do not compile are explicitly excluded from the submitted
theorem set. The general Černý conjecture remains open.

If email cannot serve as the temporary delivery route, please send me
the Hill/Climb or other upload link and I will upload the full archive
immediately. I also still need confirmation that the Černý conjecture
can be provisionally admitted as an Other Open Problem / M3A target.

Best regards,
Qichao Wang
